research_attempts.query_text: George B Tweed; NARA OSS index and official Archives context; CIA Reading Room exact-name check; exact-name and meaningful variants; OSS, Army, Navy, rank and unit clues; employer and occupation 1940; obituary, institutional, newspaper, directory, Library of Congress and archival searches; Box 791; protected identifiers used only in private official-record comparison
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, search snippets, unsourced genealogy, people-finder pages, postwar-only employment leads and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier or personnel-file bridge were rejected. Historical occupation codes and military service were not silently converted into employers. George R. Tweed was rejected because the indexed middle initial differs and no protected identifier or file evidence connects him.
research_attempts.research_notes: The famous George R. Tweed and other namesakes were rejected because the indexed middle initial is B and no source bridged a candidate to Box 791. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, CIA Reading Room and Library of Congress searches were checked as applicable. The index page, Army bulk file, technical documentation and relevant occupation-code pages were inspected directly; code pages 171-172, 174 and 304 were visually checked. No search-result snippet was used as sole final evidence, no access control was bypassed, and no authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
